steps.why: I first check whether one customer or everyone is affected. If the whole service is down, do not treat it as routine support.
The whole production site is down, so it is P1.
steps.guardrail: Full outage → escalate immediately. P1 is driven by impact, not just wording.

steps.why: Only one person is affected, so I start normal troubleshooting.
steps.guardrail: Do not escalate a single-user issue without wider impact.
steps.teaching_point: Check whether the issue is isolated.

steps.why: Missing customer data can become worse if we ask them to change or retry things.
steps.guardrail: Possible data loss → STOP normal processing and escalate.

steps.why: Many customers seeing API errors means it is probably systemic.
steps.teaching_point: Use scope to distinguish local vs systemic issues.

steps.why: Slow for several customers is a performance problem, not just one user's browser.

unseen_case.issue: 12 customers lost transaction history after an update
unseen_case.guardrail: Possible data loss means stop normal processing and escalate.
